subject: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@helioslabs.com>, Emma Liao <emma.liao@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal

Hi Priya / Emma,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — great to see Helios’s ingestion and model-scaling plans for H2. As promised, attached is a pragmatic renewal proposal that aims to:

- hold effective unit price for 90 days post-signature (temporary price anchor) while you migrate traffic to the new batch window
- replace a portion of the fixed commit with a volume-band swap that gives you burst capacity above baseline at a predictable uplift
- provide a one-time usage credit to smooth Q3 onboarding spikes

Key points (summary):
1) Term: 12 months with quarterly usage true-ups.
2) Commit: 600M tokens/month baseline; we propose swapping 150M/month of fixed commit into a tiered band (Band A/B/C) with step-up pricing so you only pay the uplift when you exceed baseline.
3) Temporary price hold: current unit price held for 90 days from signature for volumes up to 1.2x baseline.
4) One-time onboarding credit: $40,000 applied against first invoice.

Attached: Helios_MAProposed_20260809.pdf (proposal), usage_metrics_Q2.csv (Q2 token profile).

I flagged a couple of internal asks below to speed approvals:
- If procurement needs a PO number, please share and we’ll correlate invoices to that PO.
- If you want a staged commit start (lower baseline for the first 30 days), say the word and we’ll draft an amendment.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the banding math.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Helios_MAProposed_20260809.pdf (proposal)
Attachment: usage_metrics_Q2.csv (csv)
From: Emma Liao <emma.liao@helioslabs.com>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@helioslabs.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@procure-helios.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal

Karthik — thanks for the paper. Quick questions from our side before I loop procurement: 

1) Clarify the band pricing: what is the uplift % at Band B and Band C?
2) Will the 90-day price hold apply retroactively to usage between signature and onboarding completion if we backdate?
3) Is the $40k credit refundable or only applicable to invoices? Our Finance team prefers credits to be invoice-applied.

Also: procurement (Rajiv) asked if the contract needs any specific data residency language — Helios requires EU-data-firewall language if we spill logs to analytics vendors.

If you can confirm those points today we’ll try to finalize PO routing this week.

Cheers,
Emma
Head of ML Platforms | Helios Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal

Team — fwding Emma / Helios questions. Need guidance on:

- Band uplifts: I proposed +18% Band B, +35% Band C over baseline per-token. Is that within the playbook for a 150M swap?
- Price hold: they asked about backdating the 90-day hold to cover sign-to-go-live lag. Finance sign-off required.
- Credit treatment: procurement wants invoice-applied credits only. Ops/Finance/Legal note?
- Data residency ask: Rajiv flagged EU data firewall language — do we have a standard clause for logs/analytics vendors?

Ben — can you run the uplift math with the expected Q3 token curve from the attached CSV? Lauren — will pricing need approval from your side or can I accept the +18 / +35 bands?

Thanks — K

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal

Karthik / Lauren — ran the Q3 curve against the proposed bands (attached summary). Short take:

- +18% (Band B) / +35% (Band C) looks tight but acceptable given Helios’s consumption skew — they hit band B in ~40% of months in the simulated profile, band C only in burst scenarios.
- If we allow backdating of the 90-day hold we need to cap it to usage up to 1.2x baseline and require a 30-day staged baseline start; otherwise finance flags revenue leakage.
- Credit treatment: invoice-applied is fine. We’ll convert the $40k into a first-invoice credit in the SA.
- EU data firewall clause: Legal has a standard addendum for log-sharing that we can include as an optional schedule. I can loop Legal to prepare the redline.

Recommend: accept the bands as proposed, require PO before any backdate is applied, and commit to invoice-applied credit. If that sounds good I’ll draft the concession note for Lauren to sign-off.

Attachment: band_simulation_summary.pdf (generated by pricing)

- Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@helioslabs.com>, Emma Liao <emma.liao@helioslabs.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@procure-helios.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal: anchored price-hold + volume band swap proposal

Emma / Priya / Rajiv — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal alignment we can proceed with the following, and I’m happy to bake these into an amendment for signature: 

1) Commit and bands: baseline 600M tokens/mo; 150M/mo converted into Band B (+18%) and Band C (+35%) step-ups.
2) Temporary price hold: 90-day anchor applies from signature forward. If Helios requests backdating, we will accept backdating only after a PO is issued and with a staged baseline start (30 days) to limit revenue leakage.
3) Credit: $40,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice (invoice-applied).
4) Data residency: we will include Redwood standard log-sharing addendum; Legal will send redline.

Next steps: 
- Rajiv: if procurement can provide a PO number, we will include it in the amendment and generate an updated invoice reference.
- Emma / Priya: if you want the staged baseline (30 days), confirm and we’ll reflect it in the amendment.
- I’ll send a DocuSign link once Legal adds the log-sharing addendum (expected EOD).

We’ve also attached a short one-page concession note to speed internal approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this week.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: docusign_renewal_link.txt (DocuSign placeholder)
